text: If you are not trying to be something different from yourself, there is no more occasion for embarrassment than if you were talking in your office to a party of your own people, none whatever. It is trying to be other than one's self that unmans one. Be your own natural self and go ahead.
author: Andrew Carnegie
locator: Chapter XV, Coaching Trip and Marriage
location: Skibo Castle, Scotland and New York (presumed)
